note: WEATHER-CRAM Tier-1 baked EnvState presets. Each entry: weather id -> { name, b64 } where b64 is the base64 of a 0x2F8-byte EnvState snapshot captured (wxbake) while that weather rendered natively on a donor zone. Shipped/embedded = sync-deterministic (every peer decodes identical bytes). Freshly baked presets land in the config-dir weather-presets.local.json first; fold them here to ship. Regenerate per patch if EnvState layout ever shifts.
